coordinate_rule: world = cell*[48,32] + unchanged source_frame.offset + support_rect_logical.xy + output_texture_px/density; registration already baked once; no alignment_logical
sampling_rule: Exact separable box-area overlap of transformed raw pixel squares, premultiplied RGB and alpha, then unpremultiply and round half up. No local warp or nonuniform scale.
padding_rule: Each group uses common integer L/T/R/B = ceil(max full-nonzero-alpha overflow + 1/output_density); every phase preserves its authoritative original width/height.
whitelist_rule: Consumer must pin this entire file SHA, compare the entire group object exactly, and validate owner_expected; support is never a global NPC exception.
